evidence_policy: fresh_roots_only; previously saved evidence remains immutable under its original binding

requirement_amendment.boundary: local application, host, and assessment database files are trusted; an external direct database writer is outside the threat model
requirement_amendment.memory_authorized: application-connection integrity predicate only; it does not authenticate or distinguish external SQLite writers

acceptance_amendment.scope: fresh evidence roots only; historical roots retain their original immutable definition binding
requirements: every applicable M01-M40 requirement has a clause-specific runtime assertion
shared tests independently assert and identify every mapped clause and kind
test-backed checks bind exact passing JUnit identity, observation, source/config digest, and JUnit digest
saved-artifact-backed checks additionally apply a row-specific semantic predicate
descriptor-only checks, generic substitutions, skips, missing evidence, and legacy observation tokens cannot pass
inapplicable injected faults retain an explicit blueprint reason
acceptance_amendment.m24_authority_clarification: Stable seeded fact IDs remain valid in a fresh generation only under current trusted assessment, generation, and owner authority. Stale sessions, control IDs, generated memory snapshot IDs, cursors, leases, callbacks, and operations carrying prior-generation authority are rejected before read or mutation. Stale attempts mutate neither archived nor fresh generation; current fresh authority may operate on the same stable seeded fact ID.
